quiz_map.support: It cannot tell you what the person typed.
The matching `Workload` values are `Copilot`, `ConnectedAIApp` and `AIApp`.
`AppHost` names the application that hosted the chat.
For users with a non-E5 licence, audit records are retained for 180 days.
A `claude_*_viewed` activity means a Claude app loaded content, not that a person viewed it.
Set `created_at.lt` at least 1 minute in the past, or late-indexed activities are dropped for good
`user_id` does not change when the user's email or display name changes, so Anthropic says to use `user_id`, not `email_address`, as the primary join key.
Both are members of the procurement team that owns the file.
The CopilotInteraction audit record holds message identifiers and resource references, and it does not hold the words of the prompt or of the answer.
records with the same ThreadId belong to one conversation
If the resource carries a sensitivity label, a classification tag such as Confidential, the entry also has a SensitivityLabelId.
Treat ClientIP as a lead, and confirm the location in the sign-in log of the identity provider, the system that checks who is signing in.
The user_id does not change when the user's email or display name changes, so Anthropic says to use user_id, not email_address, as the primary join key.
To learn the name, pass the claude_file_id to the file metadata endpoint, which needs a Compliance Access Key with the read:compliance_user_data scope.
Copilot's UserId and UserKey correspond to Claude's actor.email_address and actor.user_id.
A viewed activity, such as claude_chat_viewed, means a Claude app loaded content, not that a person viewed it.
Most calls to the Compliance API itself emit compliance_api_accessed activities, and their actor is an api_actor.
Group the records by ThreadId. Each group is one conversation.
An empty search soon after an event proves nothing
records with the same ThreadId belong to one conversation
For Copilot, data from the messages is stored in a hidden folder in the mailbox of the user who runs the AI app.

unverified.item: Copilot audit records are retained 180 days by default
unverified.why: Microsoft does not name the Copilot workload explicitly; this follows from the documented rule that the Audit (Premium) one-year default covers only the AzureActiveDirectory, Exchange, OneDrive and SharePoint workloads and all other activities are retained 180 days by default
unverified.handled: stated with the reasoning shown in lesson section 4 and as 'by default' in the room; a tenant with a custom audit retention policy differs

unverified.item: Time for a CopilotInteraction record to become searchable
unverified.why: Microsoft gives 60 to 90 minutes only for core services (Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams) and says other services might take longer; Copilot is not named
unverified.handled: softened to 'no guaranteed time; typically 60 to 90 minutes for core services; might be longer'
